values.note: $24 a night for a nonelectric site, $46 for an electric site (one electric rate class $40), the same in the 2026, 2027 and 2028 rate tables (peak season May 1 - Oct 30).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233523/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-01 to 2026-10-30: STANDARD NONELECTRIC $24, STANDARD ELECTRIC $46), read 2026-10-20

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A233523 (125 reservable STANDARD ELECTRIC sites: 101 list 50-amp, 24 list 30-amp; 76 of the 50-amp sites list sewer, 129 list water) + campground amenities (Electric/Water/Sewer Hookups), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 181 reservable overnight sites (125 electric, 56 nonelectric) besides 5 day-use shelters, in seven loops; rec.gov says 'nearly 200'. Listed max vehicle lengths mostly 45-60 ft, up to 70; four sites list 85-108 ft, left out of max_rig_ft as likely driveway figures. Seven nonelectric sites are pull-through, the rest back-in.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/search/campsites?fq=asset_id%3A233523&size=1000 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry, type), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Showers, flush toilets and drinking water are seasonal. Rental mooring slips (first-come for campers), boat ramp, swimming beach.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233523 (Facilities: 'hot showers, playgrounds, boat ramp, rental mooring slips and a dump station'; amenities: Flush Toilets (Seasonal), Showers (Seasonal), Drinking Water (peak season), Dump Station), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 'All reservations must be made on www.recreation.gov or by calling (877) 444-6777 prior to arrival'; changes cannot be made at the facility. Reservations accepted up to the day of arrival (cutoff 0 days). Stay limit 14 nights in a rolling 30 days. 2-night weekend minimum (holidays excepted) and 3-night holiday-weekend minimum per the rec.gov facility rules (not marked soft).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233523 (notice and facility_use_fee_description on reservations; facility_rules maxStay 14 rolling 30 days, minWeekendStay 2 'Ignore Holidays', minHolidayWeekendStay 3, reservationCutOff 0), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed $24-46 and 50-amp/water/sewer (now manual). Added 181 reservable sites (to 70 ft, some pull-through), seasonal showers/flush toilets/water, dump, and booking on rec.gov only (no walk-up: reservations must be made before arrival), 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday minimum, 14-night max. Not stated: booking window (left inherited), campground season (rate seasons only), Senior/Access discount (left inherited).
